1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.PolygonPetal
2 
3 /-! A face-star development of a dome, with whole facets and all base-petal comparisons proved. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
6 
7 /-- A dome has one original base facet adjacent to every other facet. -/
8 structure Dome (P : ConvexPolyhedron) where
9   base : P.Face
10   side_shares_base : ∀ F : P.Face, F ≠ base → P.ShareEdge base F
11 
12 namespace Dome
13 
14 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (dome : P.Dome)
15 
16 /-- The original hinges around the base contain a tree on all whole facets. -/
17 theorem exists_face_star :
18     ∃ hinges : SimpleGraph P.Face, hinges.IsTree ∧ hinges ≤ P.dualGraph ∧
19       ∀ F G, hinges.Adj F G → F = dome.base ∨ G = dome.base := by
20   let star : SimpleGraph P.Face := {
21     Adj := fun F G => F ≠ G ∧ (F = dome.base ∨ G = dome.base)
22     symm := fun _ _ h => ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩
23     loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩ }
24   have connected : star.Connected := by
25     rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
26     refine ⟨dome.base, ?_⟩
27     intro F
28     by_cases same : dome.base = F
29     · subst F
30       exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
31     · exact (show star.Adj dome.base F from ⟨same, Or.inl rfl⟩).reachable
32   obtain ⟨hinges, inside_star, tree⟩ := connected.exists_isTree_le
33   refine ⟨hinges, tree, ?_, fun _ _ edge => (inside_star edge).2⟩
34   intro F G edge
35   obtain ⟨different, at_base⟩ := inside_star edge
36   rcases at_base with rfl | rfl
37   · exact dome.side_shares_base G different.symm
38   · exact dome.base.shareEdge_symm F (dome.side_shares_base F different)
39 
40 /-- Intermediate construction: the base is separated from every attached whole facet. -/
41 structure Development where
42   place : P.Face → Space →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane
43   rigid : ∀ F, ∀ x ∈ F.val, ∀ y ∈ F.val, dist (place F x) (place F y) = dist x y
44   joined : ∀ F, Set.EqOn (place dome.base) (place F) (dome.base.val ∩ F.val)
45   base_safe : ∀ F, F ≠ dome.base →
46     Disjoint (interior (place dome.base '' dome.base.val)) (interior (place F '' F.val))
47   farther : ∀ F, F ≠ dome.base → ∀ x y : P.Vertex,
48     (x : Space) ∈ dome.base.val → (x : Space) ∉ F.val →
49     (y : Space) ∈ F.val → (y : Space) ∉ dome.base.val →
50     dist (x : Space) y < dist (place dome.base x) (place F y)
51   outward : ∀ F, F ≠ dome.base →
52     ∀ a ∈ (dome.base.val ∩ F.val) ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space),
53     ∀ b ∈ (dome.base.val ∩ F.val) ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space), a ≠ b →
54     ∀ x ∈ dome.base.val, ∀ y ∈ F.val,
55       OppositeHingeSides (place dome.base a) (place dome.base b) (place dome.base x) (place F y)
56 
57 /-- Construct all outward polygonal attachments with no assumptions about their mutual separation. -/
58 theorem exists_development : Nonempty dome.Development := by
59   classical
60   obtain ⟨base_place, base_rigid⟩ := dome.base.exists_rigid_placement
61   have attachments (F : {F : P.Face // F ≠ dome.base}) :=
62     dome.base.exists_polygon_petal F.val (dome.side_shares_base F.val F.property) base_place base_rigid
63   choose side rigid joined base_safe farther outward using attachments
64   let place (F : P.Face) : Space →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane :=
65     if h : F = dome.base then base_place else side ⟨F, h⟩
66   have at_base : place dome.base = base_place := by simp [place]
67   have at_side (F : P.Face) (h : F ≠ dome.base) : place F = side ⟨F, h⟩ := by simp [place, h]
68   refine ⟨⟨place, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
69   · intro F
70     by_cases h : F = dome.base
71     · subst F
72       rw [at_base]
73       exact base_rigid
74     · rw [at_side F h]
75       exact rigid ⟨F, h⟩
76   · intro F
77     by_cases h : F = dome.base
78     · subst F
79       exact fun _ _ => rfl
80     · rw [at_base, at_side F h]
81       exact joined ⟨F, h⟩
82   · intro F h
83     rw [at_base, at_side F h]
84     exact base_safe ⟨F, h⟩
85   · intro F h
86     rw [at_base, at_side F h]
87     exact farther ⟨F, h⟩
88   · intro F h
89     rw [at_base, at_side F h]
90     exact outward ⟨F, h⟩
91 
92 /-- After the remaining petal-pair comparisons, the development is a public original-edge unfolding. -/
93 theorem Development.hasEdgeUnfolding (net : dome.Development)
94     (petals_safe : ∀ F G : P.Face, F ≠ dome.base → G ≠ dome.base → F ≠ G →
95       Disjoint (interior (net.place F '' F.val)) (interior (net.place G '' G.val))) :
96     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
97   obtain ⟨hinges, tree, original, star⟩ := dome.exists_face_star
98   refine ⟨⟨fun F => net.place F, hinges, tree, fun _ _ edge => original edge, net.rigid, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
99   · intro F G edge x hx
100     rcases star F G edge with rfl | rfl
101     · exact net.joined G hx
102     · exact (net.joined F ⟨hx.2, hx.1⟩).symm
103   · intro F G different
104     by_cases fbase : F = dome.base
105     · subst F
106       exact net.base_safe G different.symm
107     by_cases gbase : G = dome.base
108     · subst G
109       exact (net.base_safe F different).symm
110     exact petals_safe F G fbase gbase different
111 
112 end Dome
113 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
